rationale: Complete English text is useful for discovery but is not canonical authority
Canonical claims require admitted diplomatic French evidence
New labels remain local until upstream assigns tags
Maintainer feedback must be integrable without changing stable source IDs
TeX comments are historical source bytes but do not create live semantic units
Content and errata generate semantic units; masters registries bibliography and backmatter remain exact file evidence only
Known Stacks vocabulary must be searched before a lexical zero can become a residual
Hyphenated and closed forms are distinct search evidence but the same stable topic
